blocks.text: **as** bog'lovchisi ikki asosiy ma'noga ega: 1) **vaqt** — «... -ayotganda», «... paytida», «... -gan sari»; 2) **sabab** — «... -gani uchun», «... ekan». Vaqt bog'lovchilari **when** va **while** sizga tanish (→ qizil kitob, 14, 98, 105-darslar; Past Continuous — → 6-dars). as ularga o'xshaydi, lekin o'z chegaralari bor: u har doim ham when o'rnida kelavermaydi. Qaysi ma'no ekanini gapning mazmuni va zamon ko'rsatadi.

rows: **As** I opened the door, the cat ran out.
**As** we were leaving, it began to snow.
**As** the day went on, it got hotter.
**As** it was late, we took a taxi.

blocks.text: as = when / while: ikki harakat bir paytda

as ikki harakat bir vaqtda sodir bo'lganini bildiradi. Ikkala harakat qisqa bo'lsa — ikkalasi ham Past Simple: **As** she walked in, everyone stood up. Biri uzunroq fon bo'lsa, unga **Past Continuous** qo'yiladi: **As** I was getting out of the car, my phone rang. **just as** — «**aynan** ... paytda», «**endigina** ... -ganda»: ikki voqea bir lahzaga to'g'ri keldi.

items.text: **As** I walked into the room, everyone stopped talking.
Jasur cut his finger **as** he was slicing the onions.
The lights went off **just as** the film reached its best moment.
items.translation: Film **aynan** eng qiziq joyiga **yetganda**, chiroqlar o'chdi.

blocks.text: Ikki narsa birga, asta-sekin o'zgarib borsa, as o'zbekchadagi «**-gan sari**», «**... sayin**» ga to'g'ri keladi: **As** the day went on, the weather got worse. Ko'pincha bir qismda qiyosiy daraja bo'ladi (→ 105–106-darslar): **As** prices rise, people buy **less**. Bu ma'noda as o'rniga while yoki when ishlatilmaydi.

items.text: **As** the evening went on, the music got louder and louder.
items.translation: Kech **o'tgan sari**, musiqa tobora balandlashib bordi.

items.text: **As** I get older, I worry less about other people's opinions.
items.translation: **Yoshim ulg'aygan sari**, boshqalarning fikri meni kamroq tashvishlantiradi.

blocks.text: as ko'pincha «chunki» ma'nosida keladi, xuddi **since** kabi. Bunda sabab odatda **tinglovchiga allaqachon ma'lum** yoki ikkinchi darajali bo'ladi, shuning uchun as gapi ko'pincha gap boshida turadi. Yangi, muhim sababni aytish yoki **Why?** savoliga javob berish uchun esa **because** ishlatiladi: Why are you late? — **Because** the metro stopped («As the metro stopped» emas). as va since rasmiyroq eshitiladi; og'zaki nutqda ko'pincha because yoki so aytiladi.

items.text: **As** it was getting late, we decided to call a taxi.
items.translation: Kech **bo'lib qolgani uchun**, taksi chaqirishga qaror qildik.

items.text: **Since** you're here, can you help me move this sofa?
items.translation: Shu yerda **ekansan**, divanni surishga yordamlashib yuborasanmi?

items.text: I stayed at home, **as** I had a lot of work to finish.
items.translation: Tugatadigan ishim ko'p **bo'lgani uchun**, uyda qoldim.

blocks.text: as va when: qachon faqat when

as faqat **bir paytdagi** harakatlar uchun vaqt bog'lovchisi bo'la oladi. Hayot davri yoki yosh haqida (bolaligimda, talabalik paytimda), ketma-ket harakatlar haqida (uyga kelgach, dush qabul qildim) va kelajakdagi bir martalik voqea haqida **when** ishlatiladi. **as + holat** (As I was young, As I was a student) eshituvchiga «**... -gani uchun**» bo'lib eshitiladi.

rows: **When** I was a child, I lived in Bukhara.
As I was a child ... = bola bo'lganim uchun
**When** I got home, I had a shower.
Call me as you arrive — ishlatilmaydi
**As** / **When** I was leaving, it started to rain.

blocks.text: Ba'zan as ikki ma'noli bo'lib qoladi: **As** I was going out, I didn't answer the phone — «chiqayotganim uchun» ham, «chiqayotganimda» ham. Aniqlik kerak bo'lsa — vaqt uchun **while** / **when**, sabab uchun **because** ishlating.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «**As** I was young, I lived in Fergana» («yoshligimda») → **When** I was young (as + holat sabab bo'lib eshitiladi). 2) Why? savoliga as bilan javob berish: «— Why did you leave? — **As** I was tired.» → **Because** I was tired. 3) «Call me **as** you get home» → Call me **when** you get home. 4) as (bog'lovchi) va like (o'xshatish) ni adashtirish — bu haqida → 117-dars.

Tarjima orqali tekshiring: as ni «**-ayotganda**» yoki «**-gan sari**» deb o'girish mumkin bo'lsa — vaqt; «**-gani uchun**» yoki «**... ekan**» mos kelsa — sabab. «**-ganimda / bo'lganimda**» (yosh, davr, ketma-ketlik) bo'lsa — when.

rows: **As** she came in, we stood up.
**As** I was cooking, the lights went out.
The bus left **just as** I arrived.
**As** it was raining, we stayed in.

examples.title: **As** = while: two things at the same time
examples.description: as — «... -ayotganda», «... paytida»: ikki harakat bir vaqtda. Ikkala harakat qisqa bo'lsa — ikkalasi ham Past Simple.

sentences.text: The audience stood up and cheered **as** the band came back on stage.
sentences.translation: Guruh sahnaga qaytib **chiqayotganda**, tomoshabinlar o'rnidan turib olqishladi.

sentences.text: **As** I opened the front door, the cat shot out into the street.
sentences.translation: Kirish eshigini **ochganimda**, mushuk o'qdek ko'chaga otilib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Madina smiled **as** she read the message from her old school friend.
sentences.translation: Eski maktabdoshidan kelgan xabarni **o'qiyotib**, Madina jilmaydi.

sentences.text: Tom hummed a song to himself **as** he prepared the dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatni **tayyorlarkan**, Tom o'ziga qo'shiq xirgoyi qildi.

sentences.text: **As** the plane touched down in Tashkent, some passengers started clapping.
sentences.translation: Samolyot Toshkentga **qo'nayotganda**, ba'zi yo'lovchilar qarsak chala boshladi.

sentences.text: Please switch off your phones **as** you enter the exam hall.
sentences.translation: Imtihon zaliga **kirayotganda**, telefonlaringizni o'chiring.

sentences.text: The crowd went silent **as** the president began to speak.
sentences.translation: Prezident gapira **boshlaganda**, olomon jim bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod checked his watch nervously **as** the train pulled out of the station.
sentences.translation: Poyezd vokzaldan **jo'nab ketayotganda**, Bekzod asabiylashib soatiga qaradi.

sentences.text: **As** she crossed the finish line, Nilufar burst into tears of joy.
sentences.translation: Marra chizig'ini **kesib o'tarkan**, Nilufar quvonchdan yig'lab yubordi.

sentences.text: The children rushed to the window **as** the first snow began to fall.
sentences.translation: Ilk qor **yog'a boshlaganda**, bolalar derazaga yugurishdi.

examples.title: **As** + past continuous and **just as**
examples.description: Uzunroq fon harakat — as + Past Continuous: as I was leaving. just as — «aynan ... paytda», «endigina ... -ganda».

sentences.text: Aziz dropped his phone into the river **as** he was taking a photo from the bridge.
sentences.translation: Ko'prikdan surat **olayotganda**, Aziz telefonini daryoga tushirib yubordi.

sentences.text: **As** we were leaving the restaurant, it started to pour with rain.
sentences.translation: Restorandan **chiqayotganimizda**, jala quya boshladi.

sentences.text: The lights went out **just as** I was finishing my presentation.
sentences.translation: **Aynan** taqdimotimni **tugatayotganimda**, chiroqlar o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: **Just as** we sat down to eat, the doorbell rang.
sentences.translation: **Endigina** ovqatlanishga **o'tirganimizda**, eshik qo'ng'irog'i chalindi.

sentences.text: Kate spotted an old friend **as** she was waiting at passport control.
sentences.translation: Pasport nazoratida **navbat kutayotganda**, Keyt eski do'stini ko'rib qoldi.

sentences.text: **As** I was driving home, I suddenly remembered the meeting.
sentences.translation: Uyga mashinada **ketayotganimda**, birdan yig'ilish esimga tushdi.

sentences.text: The bus pulled away **just as** Jasur reached the stop.
sentences.translation: Jasur bekatga **yetib kelgan zahoti**, avtobus jo'nab ketdi.

sentences.text: Somebody stole Emma's bag **as** she was looking at a map of the city.
sentences.translation: Shahar xaritasiga **qarab turganida**, kimdir Emmaning sumkasini o'g'irlab ketdi.

sentences.text: **Just as** I was about to give up, the company called me back.
sentences.translation: **Endi** taslim **bo'lmoqchi bo'lib turganimda**, kompaniya menga qayta qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: The phone rang **just as** Dilnoza was stepping into the shower.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **endigina** dushga **kirayotganda**, telefon jiringladi.

examples.title: **As** for gradual change: as time went on
examples.description: Ikki narsa birga o'zgarib boradi: as = «... -gan sari», «... sayin». Bu ma'noda while yoki when ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: **As** the day went on, the queue outside the embassy got longer.
sentences.translation: Kun **o'tgan sari**, elchixona oldidagi navbat uzayib bordi.

sentences.text: **As** you get older, you start to appreciate your parents more.
sentences.translation: **Yoshing ulg'aygan sari**, ota-onangni ko'proq qadrlay boshlaysan.

sentences.text: The roads became more dangerous **as** the snow got heavier.
sentences.translation: Qor **kuchaygan sari**, yo'llar xavfliroq bo'lib bordi.

sentences.text: My English improved quickly **as** I spent more time with British colleagues.
sentences.translation: Britaniyalik hamkasblarim bilan ko'proq vaqt **o'tkazgan sari**, ingliz tilim tez yaxshilandi.

sentences.text: **As** the film went on, I realised I had seen it before.
sentences.translation: Film davom **etgan sari**, uni ilgari ko'rganimni anglab yetdim.

sentences.text: Prices in Samarkand go up every summer **as** more tourists arrive.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar **ko'paygan sari**, Samarqandda har yozi narxlar oshadi.

sentences.text: Oliver became more confident **as** the interview continued.
sentences.translation: Suhbat davom **etgan sari**, Oliverning o'ziga ishonchi ortib bordi.

sentences.text: Our garden looks more beautiful every year **as** the trees grow.
sentences.translation: Daraxtlar **o'sgan sari**, bog'imiz yildan yilga chiroyliroq ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Many traditional jobs are disappearing **as** technology develops.
sentences.translation: Texnologiya **rivojlangan sari**, ko'plab an'anaviy kasblar yo'qolib bormoqda.

sentences.text: It became harder to breathe **as** we climbed higher into the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'ga balandroq **ko'tarilgan sari**, nafas olish qiyinlashdi.

examples.title: **As** = because: a reason the listener knows
examples.description: as = because, since: sabab ko'pincha gap boshida va tinglovchiga tanish. O'zbekchada «-gani uchun», «... ekan».

sentences.text: **As** the museum was closed on Monday, we spent the day at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanba kuni yopiq **bo'lgani uchun**, kunni bozorda o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: **As** you're not feeling well, why don't you go home early?
sentences.translation: O'zingizni yaxshi **his qilmayotgan ekansiz**, nega uyga ertaroq ketmaysiz?

sentences.text: We took a taxi **as** there were no buses after midnight.
sentences.translation: Yarim tundan keyin avtobus **bo'lmagani uchun**, taksiga o'tirdik.

sentences.text: Aziz was asked to meet the visitors from Berlin **as** he speaks fluent German.
sentences.translation: Nemis tilida ravon **gapirgani uchun**, Berlinlik mehmonlarni kutib olish Azizga topshirildi.

sentences.text: I'll do the shopping this time, **as** you did it last week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta sen **qilganing uchun**, bu safar xaridni men qilaman.

sentences.text: Sarah didn't apply for the job **as** she didn't have a driving licence.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilik guvohnomasi **bo'lmagani uchun**, Sara bu ishga ariza topshirmadi.

sentences.text: **As** it's your first day, nobody expects you to know everything.
sentences.translation: Bugun birinchi kuning **ekan**, hech kim sendan hamma narsani bilishni kutmaydi.

sentences.text: The match was postponed **as** the pitch was frozen.
sentences.translation: Maydon muzlab **qolgani uchun**, o'yin keyinga qoldirildi.

sentences.text: **Since** we've got a free evening, shall we try the new Korean restaurant?
sentences.translation: Bo'sh kechamiz bor **ekan**, yangi koreys restoranini sinab ko'ramizmi?

sentences.text: I couldn't contact anyone **as** my phone had run out of battery.
sentences.translation: Telefonimning quvvati **tugab qolgani uchun**, hech kim bilan bog'lana olmadim.

examples.title: **As**, **since** or **because**?
examples.description: as va since — tanish, ikkinchi darajali sabab; because — yangi, asosiy sabab va Why? savoliga javob. because of — predlog (+ ot).

sentences.text: Why are you so late? — **Because** the metro broke down between two stations.
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik kechikding? — **Chunki** metro ikki bekat orasida buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: **Since** you've already seen the film, let's watch something else.
sentences.translation: Filmni allaqachon **ko'rgan ekansan**, boshqa narsa ko'raylik.

sentences.text: I'm learning Korean **because** I want to work in Seoul one day.
sentences.translation: Bir kun kelib Seulda ishlamoqchi **bo'lganim uchun** koreys tilini o'rganyapman.

sentences.text: **As** we have plenty of time, let's walk to the station instead of taking the bus.
sentences.translation: Vaqtimiz yetarli **ekan**, avtobusga o'tirmasdan vokzalgacha piyoda boraylik.

sentences.text: Kate only took the job **because of** the generous salary.
sentences.translation: Keyt ishni faqat yaxshi maoshi **tufayli** oldi.

sentences.text: **Since** nobody had any questions, the lecturer finished early.
sentences.translation: Hech kimda savol **bo'lmagani uchun**, ma'ruzachi erta tugatdi.

sentences.text: **As** Jasur is the only one with a car, he usually drives us to football.
sentences.translation: Mashina faqat Jasurda **bo'lgani uchun**, odatda u bizni futbolga olib boradi.

sentences.text: I'm not angry **because** you were late — I'm angry **because** you didn't call.
sentences.translation: Kechikkaning **uchun** emas, qo'ng'iroq qilmaganing **uchun** jahlim chiqyapti.

sentences.text: We decided to stay in, **as** the forecast was for heavy snow.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qor yog'ishi **kutilgani uchun**, uyda qolishga qaror qildik.

sentences.text: Was the flight cancelled **because of** the strike or **because of** the weather?
sentences.translation: Reys ish tashlash **tufayli** bekor qilindimi yoki ob-havo **tufayli**mi?

examples.title: **As** or **when**?
examples.description: Hayot davri va yosh, ketma-ket harakat va kelajakdagi voqea uchun — when. as + holat «-gani uchun» deb tushuniladi.

sentences.text: **When** I was a student, I lived on bread and tea for months.
sentences.translation: Talaba **bo'lganimda**, oylab non va choy bilan kun o'tkazardim.

sentences.text: **As** I was a student, I got a big discount on the train ticket.
sentences.translation: Talaba **bo'lganim uchun**, poyezd chiptasiga katta chegirma oldim.

sentences.text: My grandfather moved to Tashkent **when** he was twenty.
sentences.translation: Bobom yigirma **yoshida** Toshkentga ko'chib kelgan.

sentences.text: **When** the meeting finished, everyone went to the canteen for lunch.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **tugagach**, hamma tushlik qilish uchun oshxonaga ketdi.

sentences.text: **As** Emma was walking home, she heard someone calling her name.
sentences.translation: Emma uyga **ketayotganda**, kimdir uning ismini chaqirayotganini eshitdi.

sentences.text: James was painfully shy **when** he was a teenager, but now he's a TV presenter.
sentences.translation: O'smirlik **paytida** Jeyms juda uyatchan edi, endi esa televideniyeda boshlovchi.

sentences.text: **As** I was hungry, I stopped at a café on the way.
sentences.translation: Qornim **och bo'lgani uchun**, yo'lda bir kafega kirdim.

sentences.text: Call me **when** you land, and I'll come and pick you up.
sentences.translation: **Qo'nganingizda** qo'ng'iroq qiling, kelib olib ketaman.

sentences.text: Life was much slower **when** there were no mobile phones.
sentences.translation: Mobil telefonlar **yo'q paytda** hayot ancha sekin edi.

sentences.text: The guests arrived **just as** we were taking the cake out of the oven.
sentences.translation: Tortni duxovkadan **endigina olayotganimizda**, mehmonlar kelib qolishdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a terrible morning
examples.description: Hamkasblar suhbati: as vaqt va sabab ma'nosida, just as va since bir hikoyada.

sentences.text: — You look exhausted! Did something happen **as** you were coming to work?
sentences.translation: — Juda charchagan ko'rinyapsan! Ishga **kelayotganingda** biror narsa bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: — Everything went wrong! **As** I was locking the door, the key broke in the lock.
sentences.translation: — Hamma narsa chappasiga ketdi! Eshikni **qulflayotganimda**, kalit qulf ichida sinib qoldi.

sentences.text: — Oh no! What did you do, **since** you couldn't leave the flat open?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Kvartirani ochiq qoldira **olmaganing uchun** nima qilding?

sentences.text: — I called a locksmith, and **as** he was fixing it, my boss phoned.
sentences.translation: — Usta chaqirdim, u qulfni **tuzatayotganda** boshlig'im qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: — Let me guess: she wanted you in early **as** the clients were coming at nine?
sentences.translation: — Topay-chi: mijozlar soat to'qqizda **kelishayotgani uchun** seni erta chaqirdimi?

sentences.text: — Exactly. And **as** I ran to the bus stop, it started pouring with rain.
sentences.translation: — Xuddi shunday. Bekatga **yugurib ketayotganimda**, jala quya boshladi.

sentences.text: — Poor you! Did you catch the bus, or did it leave **just as** you got there?
sentences.translation: — Bechora! Avtobusga ulgurdingmi yoki u sen **yetib borgan zahoti** jo'nab ketdimi?

sentences.text: — It left **just as** I reached the stop, of course.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, men bekatga **yetib kelganimda** endigina jo'nab ketdi.

sentences.text: — Well, **as** you're here now, let's get you a strong coffee.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, endi shu yerda **ekansan**, senga achchiq qahva olib beraylik.

sentences.text: — Thanks. I'll need it, **as** the clients are already waiting upstairs!
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Kerak bo'ladi, **chunki** mijozlar allaqachon yuqorida kutib turishibdi!

examples.title: Mixed: time, change and reason
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: as (vaqt, birga o'zgarish, sabab), just as, since va when murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: **As** the number of electric cars grows, cities need far more charging points.
sentences.translation: Elektromobillar soni **ortgan sari**, shaharlarga ancha ko'p quvvatlash shoxobchalari kerak bo'lmoqda.

sentences.text: Nobody noticed the thief, **as** everyone was busy watching the street performer.
sentences.translation: Hamma ko'cha artistini tomosha qilish bilan **band bo'lgani uchun**, o'g'rini hech kim payqamadi.

sentences.text: **Since** the deadline is tomorrow, I'm afraid we'll have to work through lunch.
sentences.translation: Muddat ertaga **bo'lgani uchun**, afsuski, tushlik payti ham ishlashimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Kate's hands were shaking **as** she opened the envelope with her exam results.
sentences.translation: Imtihon natijalari solingan konvertni **ochayotganda**, Keytning qo'llari titrardi.

sentences.text: My grandmother grew up in Fergana **when** there were no tall buildings at all.
sentences.translation: Buvim Farg'onada hali baland binolar umuman **yo'q paytda** voyaga yetgan.

sentences.text: **As** inflation rises, more families are struggling to pay their bills.
sentences.translation: Inflyatsiya **oshgan sari**, to'lovlarini to'lashga qiynalayotgan oilalar ko'payib boryapti.

sentences.text: The fire alarm went off **just as** the professor started his lecture.
sentences.translation: Professor ma'ruzasini **endigina boshlaganda**, yong'in signali chalinib ketdi.

sentences.text: **As** Bekzod had already paid for the course, he decided to finish it.
sentences.translation: Kursga allaqachon **to'lagani uchun**, Bekzod uni oxiriga yetkazishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: We'll have to leave without Oliver **as** he still hasn't replied to our messages.
sentences.translation: Oliver hali ham xabarlarimizga **javob bermagani uchun**, usiz ketishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Did you hear that strange noise **as** we were going past the old factory?
sentences.translation: Eski zavod yonidan **o'tayotganimizda** anavi g'alati shovqinni eshitdingmi?
